title: Radiance MXFP4 (2x GPU, data-parallel) -- full hardware

panels.title: Model state (live)
panels.description: Which model is loaded on each instance + whether it is ready, from the state-collector textfile metric.

panels.title: Spec acceptance %
panels.description: Accepted / draft tokens over 5m. The headline spec-decode efficiency number. Green >60%, amber 45-60%, red <45%.

panels.title: Hottest GPU temp (C)
panels.description: Max junction temp across cards. R9700 throttles near 95-100C.

panels.title: Prefill (tok/s)
panels.description: Total prefill tokens/s across all sources (compute + cache hit + offload), 1m rate.

panels.title: Decode (tok/s)
panels.description: Decode (generation) tokens/s, 1m rate.

panels.title: Throughput (tok/s)
panels.description: Decode + prefill tokens/s by source (1m rate).

panels.title: Spec acceptance (%)
panels.description: Accepted / draft tokens (5m). Total + per instance. The core spec-decode efficiency number.

panels.title: Latency (s)
panels.description: Time-to-first-token percentiles + inter-token latency p50.

panels.title: Per-position accepted (tok/s)
panels.description: Accepted tokens/s per spec position -- the draft-depth decay curve (which positions are productive).

panels.title: Concurrency
panels.description: Requests running + waiting per instance.

panels.title: KV cache usage (%)
panels.description: GPU KV cache occupancy per instance.

panels.title: GPU utilization (%)
panels.description: GPU busy % per card.

panels.title: VRAM (GiB + %)
panels.description: VRAM used (GiB, left) + % of total (right).

panels.title: GPU power (W)
panels.description: Drawn power vs cap per card.

panels.title: GPU temps (C)
panels.description: Edge / junction / memory temps per card.

panels.title: GPU clocks (Hz)
panels.description: Shader + memory clock per card (auto-scaled to MHz).

panels.title: GPU fan
panels.description: Fan speed per card.

panels.title: Throttle & limits
panels.description: Power-limit ratio (0-1, left) + thermal headroom to crit (C, right).

panels.title: PCIe link
panels.description: PCIe link width (lanes, left) + speed (GT/s, right). Card1 is x1.

panels.title: GPU mem & volt
panels.description: UMC busy % + GTT % (left) + core voltage (right).

panels.title: GPU ECC / AER / RAS faults
panels.description: Sum of fatal AER + fatal RAS + bad VRAM pages. 0 = clean; any increase = investigate.

panels.title: Throttle reason flags (derived)
panels.description: 1 when the card is power- or thermally throttling.

panels.title: GPU throttle status (raw)
panels.description: Raw throttle status bitfield per card.

panels.title: CPU (usage % + load)
panels.description: CPU usage % (left) + load average (right).

panels.title: CPU power (W)
panels.description: CPU package power (RAPL).

panels.title: Host memory
panels.description: RAM used + swap used.

panels.title: Disk
panels.description: Root disk used % (left) + I/O read/write (right).

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Network rx/tx (excl. loopback).

panels.title: RAM tier size
panels.description: Pinned CPU KV tier total.

panels.title: Disk tier used %
panels.description: Shared fs tier fill vs cap.

panels.title: Offload hit rate %
panels.description: External (offload) prefix-cache hit rate.

panels.title: Disk tier blocks
panels.description: Blocks in the fs tier.

panels.title: RAM tier allocated (per engine)
panels.description: Pinned RAM tier per engine.

panels.title: Disk tier bytes vs cap
panels.description: fs tier used vs hard cap.

panels.title: Offload transfer rate (B/s)
panels.description: Offload restore/store throughput.

panels.title: Lookup terminal outcomes (/s)
panels.description: Offload lookup terminal outcomes per second.

panels.title: Lookup chunk outcomes (/s)
panels.description: Offload chunk-level lookup outcomes per second.

panels.title: Lookup served tokens/s
panels.description: Tokens served from the offload tier per second.

panels.title: Tier capacity vs used (bytes)
panels.description: Per-tier capacity vs used bytes.

panels.title: Tier hit blocks/tokens
panels.description: Per-tier hit blocks + tokens per second.

panels.title: Tier stall / evictions (/s)
panels.description: Per-tier stall seconds + evictions + miss-evictions.

panels.title: Promotion initiated / refused (/s)
panels.description: Offload promotion initiated vs refused (with no-evictable reason).

panels.title: Deferral lifecycle (/s) + depth
panels.description: Lookup deferral lifecycle per second + average deferral depth (steps).

panels.title: CPU tier headroom / FS backlog
panels.description: CPU tier admission headroom (left) + FS tier cascade backlog (right).
